final: SELECT tradekind, AVG(pair_avg) AS avg_analyst_count, AVG(pair_avg - overall_mean) AS avg_amount_above_overall_mean, AVG(pair_avg) / AVG(AVG(pair_avg)) OVER () AS avg_divided_by_mean_across_types FROM (SELECT p.*, AVG(pair_avg) OVER () AS overall_mean FROM (SELECT sf.transref, tr.tradekind, AVG(sf.anlycount) AS pair_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS sf JOIN transactionrecord AS tx ON tx.transreg = sf.transref JOIN trader AS tr ON tr.tradereg = tx.trdref GROUP BY sf.transref, tr.tradekind) AS p) WHERE pair_avg > overall_mean GROUP BY tradekind
